title: Start gossipsub swarm and per-hierarchy topic subscriptions in transit main
description: Call the gossip::swarm builder from main.rs, subscribe to all configured hierarchy topics (usenet.hier.<hier>), and start the gossipsub event loop task. Wire inbound tip advertisements to group_log reconciliation (call reconcile() on received tips). Why: tip propagation and group-log convergence are the core gossip mechanism; nothing reconciles until the swarm runs.
